_comment: Source of truth for crash-relevant Windows event log entries. The collector (collect-guest.ps1 / PsLogList wrapper) reads this to know which log/source/ID pairs to extract for the crash timeline. Do not hardcode these IDs in any script.
_source: Windows System/Application event log; standard BugCheck and shutdown auditing events.

events.meaning: BugCheck record: the computer rebooted from a bug check. Contains the stop code and dump-file path. Primary post-mortem signal.
Unexpected shutdown (dirty shutdown). Confirms an ungraceful stop and its timestamp.
Kernel-Power: system rebooted without cleanly shutting down first. Correlates with a crash or hard reset.
Operating system started (boot time). Anchors the reboot that followed the crash.
Operating system is shutting down. Its presence (or absence) distinguishes a clean shutdown from a crash.
WER report bucket, may include a LiveKernelEvent / BlueScreen bucket with faulting-module details.
WHEA fatal hardware error. Relevant when the stop code is 0x124 (WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR).
